title: Declared Actions policies
summary: An actions_policies list in .yoke/merge-queue.json hands the repository's own GitHub Actions policies to the declaration: merge-queue apply creates or updates each by name and deletes undeclared repository policies, and Doctor reports the differences as drift. Without the key Yoke leaves them alone. A public repository whose required check runs on pull_request_target declares an event policy scoped to that one workflow, because GitHub blocks the event by default and the check would never report.
